header_summary:
Coordination is underway to mine the testnet 5 genesis block in alignment with the upcoming mainnet retarget event at block 975,744, with resources available for participants including solo-mining pool details and comprehensive documentation ([documentation](https://gist.github.com/ajtowns/ebb148819c6028387271e6f0dce5e1da), [mining pool](https://lapis.erisian.com.au/chain.html)). Several genesis block structure modifications have been proposed to simplify pooled mining and increase compatibility, while challenges persist regarding block height encoding inconsistencies between Bitcoin Core and common mining software ([pull request 1](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/pull/2347), [pull request 2](https://github.com/bitaxeorg/ESP-Miner/pull/2089)).

A suite of five interrelated Bitcoin Script proposals, collectively defining Tapleaf 0xc2, introduces restored and expanded scripting capabilities, enabling transaction introspection, advanced covenants, and reusable macros while maintaining backward compatibility. The framework enforces computational budgets, restricts control flow for static analysis, and provides a reference implementation for review ([BIP 440](https://github.com/jmoik/bips/blob/gsr-full/bip-0440.mediawiki), [BIP 441](https://github.com/jmoik/bips/blob/gsr-full/bip-0441.mediawiki), [OP_TX](https://github.com/jmoik/bips/blob/gsr-full/bip-unknown-optx.md), [reference implementation](https://github.com/bitcoin-gsr/bitcoin/tree/gsr)).

To mitigate the risk of hardware wallets leaking sensitive seed information via manipulated nonces, an anti-exfiltration protocol involving host participation in nonce generation has been proposed, accompanied by draft BIPs and experimental implementations ([specification and resources](https://github.com/AvilaLabs/anti-exfil), [handbook](https://anti-exfil.avilalabs.org)). The protocol has yet to undergo formal cryptographic review, and community feedback is sought to enhance its security assurances.

Enhancements to the Bitcoin BIP archive now provide clear mapping of BIP implementation status within Bitcoin Core, comprehensive release histories, and more frequent updates, improving traceability and documentation ([BIP 141 example](https://www.learnbitcoin.com/archive/bips/141), [archive](https://www.learnbitcoin.com/archive/releases)). The Eclair Lightning implementation addressed a critical vulnerability in version 0.14.0 that allowed remote memory exhaustion via improperly validated batch messages, urging users to upgrade to [version 0.14.1](https://github.com/ACINQ/eclair/blob/d769db070424ae0ab6c05975fd7c86dac8b3e1f4/docs/release-notes/eclair-v0.14.1.md) for security.

Ongoing research highlights the risk of message equivocation within Lightning's gossip network, where set reconciliation protocols can allow attackers to partition the network and extract excessive fees. Solutions focus on cryptographic commitments, including tree-based multiset hashing, to strengthen message integrity and improve detection of inconsistencies, with several reference materials and approaches under consideration ([Incremental Hashes](https://cseweb.ucsd.edu/~mihir/papers/inchash.pdf), [Elliptic Curve Multiset Hash](https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.06502), [Range-Based Set Reconciliation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.13567)).

recent_posts.title: Testnet 5 launch
recent_posts.summary: - Mining of testnet 5 genesis block will align with the mainnet retarget event at block 975,744.  - Genesis block structure has been modified to simplify pooled mining and improve compatibility.  - Differences in BIP 34 block height encoding may cause issues during blockchain initialization and bootstrapping.

recent_posts.title: [Proposal] Tapleaf 0xc2: An overview of the Great Script Restoration (GSR)
recent_posts.summary: - Five proposals collectively define Tapleaf 0xc2, expanding Bitcoin Script with advanced features and robust safeguards.  - These changes re-enable opcodes, add transaction introspection, extend primitives, and maintain backward compatibility.  - Comprehensive documentation, reference implementation, and extensive testing ensure safe deployment and encourage ongoing discussion.

recent_posts.title: Draft BIPs: anti-exfil signing for BIP340 and ECDSA, with PSBT fields
recent_posts.summary: - An anti-exfiltration protocol involves host participation to prevent device-based leakage of signing secrets.  - Two draft Bitcoin Improvement Proposals define the protocol, responsibilities, and introduce new PSBT fields.  - Formal cryptographic review is pending, and further peer feedback is strongly encouraged for security validation.

recent_posts.title: We made the bitcoin-dev mailing list readable: 15 years, 24,699 messages
recent_posts.summary: - The Bitcoin BIP archive now details BIP integration, modification versions, and includes direct documentation references.  - Archive documentation is comprehensive, covering all 74 BIPs and 137 Bitcoin Core releases from version 0.1.5 onward.  - Archive updates now occur twice daily, and user records have been unified for improved accuracy and accessibility.

recent_posts.title: Gossip Observer: New project to monitor the Lightning P2P network
recent_posts.summary: - Message equivocation enables attackers to partition the network and deceive honest nodes with conflicting updates.  - Cryptographic commitment structures, like multiset hashing and fingerprint trees, detect and localize inconsistencies efficiently.  - Community feedback is encouraged to refine these sub-protocols and strengthen defenses against message equivocation.

recent_posts.title: Disclosure: Memory-exhaustion DoS in Eclair 0.14.0
recent_posts.summary: - Eclair 0.14.0 allowed attackers to exhaust node memory, causing a denial-of-service condition.  - Improper enforcement of protocol parameters permitted unbounded buffering of commitment_signed messages with invalid batch sizes.  - The vulnerability was fixed in version 0.14.1, and users should urgently upgrade for security.

active_posts.title: [BIP Proposal] Stale Tip Relay
active_posts.summary: - The `staletip` proposal introduces optional P2P messaging to improve stale rate observability in the Bitcoin network.  - It uses BIP 434 messaging, compresses header sequences, and limits shared data and cache size for efficiency.  - Nodes gain better visibility of stale tips, enabling faster responses and improved diagnosis of network health.

active_posts.title: [bitcoindev]
active_posts.summary: - A new draft proposes standardizing enforcement policies for blockchain co-signers to improve interoperability.  - The draft covers unified policy formats, verification methods, script-enforceable conditions, and oracle attestations.  - Feedback is requested on technical issues such as serialization, blinded verification, attestation formats, and fallback paths.

active_posts.title: Quantum Landmines and Vulnerable Coin Auctions
active_posts.summary: - Several post-quantum strategies use game theory and incentives to protect cryptocurrency from quantum attacks.  - Mechanisms like Quantum Landmines, Staked Auctions, and Sats Auctions involve collateral, bidding, and time restrictions.  - Adaptive schemes combining cryptographic and economic approaches can transform system vulnerabilities into self-policing defenses.

active_posts.title: Great Consensus Cleanup Revival
active_posts.summary: - The proposal highlights vulnerabilities in Bitcoin, including timewarp attacks and inefficient legacy transaction handling.  - Solutions include retarget period adjustments, transaction constraints, and invalidation of risky small transactions.  - Some recommendations, like reducing block size and standardizing SegWit elements, have prompted community debate.

active_posts.title: Stats on compact block reconstructions
active_posts.summary: - Nodes adjusted configurations such as maximum inbound connections, blocksonly setting, and mempoolfullrbf option.  - Increased mempool activity and network congestion resulted in decreased compact block reconstruction efficiency.  - Enabling mempoolfullrbf improved reconstruction efficiency, suggesting network-wide benefits if adopted by most pools.

active_posts.title: Public key recovery for EC leaves in P2MR (BIP-360)
active_posts.summary: - The proposal introduces a method to recover EC public keys from signatures, reducing witness size.  - A recoverable EC leaf eliminates the public key script, ensuring security and streamlined witness validation.  - Modified nonce derivation and validation logic enhance security and efficiency for Pay-to-Merkle-root transactions.

today_in_history_posts.title: Removing BIP-125 Rule #5 Pinning with the Always-Replaceable Invariant
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Bitcoin Core limits original and descendant transactions that can be replaced to a total of 100.  - The Replaceability Invariant ensures no transaction becomes unreplaceable due to exceeding this limit.  - This method maintains transaction replaceability and prevents issues caused by Rule #5 pinning.

today_in_history_posts.title: Mitigating Channel Jamming with Reputation Credentials: a Protocol Sketch
today_in_history_posts.summary: - Credential tampering by intermediary nodes in payment paths can result in wasted sender credentials.  - Routing nodes generally avoid intentional attacks that would reduce their chance to earn fees.  - Effective protection mechanisms mean most remaining jamming instances are accidental node failures.

today_in_history_posts.title: CTV, APO, CAT activity on signet
today_in_history_posts.summary: - BIPs 118, 119, and 347 have enabled advanced Bitcoin script features, expanding transaction flexibility.  - APO and CTV are used for coinbase payouts, structured spending, and more secure transaction conditions.  - OP_CAT, integrated in Proof of Work faucets, dominates usage, supporting sophisticated contracts and verification methods.
